meta.title: thin a cloud by the density attribute
meta.description: The standard thinning idiom: write the standard `density` attribute from a 0..1 noise field, then let `filterByDensity` in mode 'probabilistic' keep each point with probability equal to its own density. The result is soft-edged — dense regions stay full, sparse ones fade out, with no visible boundary. Mode 'threshold' on the same input gives the hard-edged version instead.
